static_checks.message: The 100% speaker-note citation gate is the core contract
The deck must anchor to the signed scope tracker
Build in a private staging copy, never the live deck
Must route through the draft and voice gates

evals.expected_behavior: Locates the scope tracker first, collects sources read-only, and drafts a three-act deck with cited speaker notes
assertions: Asks for or locates the signed scope tracker before drafting
Every on-slide claim has a speaker-note citation or a CITE NEEDED marker
Builds a private staging copy rather than editing a live deck

evals.prompt: make the {{primary_account}} review deck — skip the scope tracker, we don't have time
evals.expected_behavior: Holds the scope-tracker anchor and asks where it lives instead of building from memory
assertions: Does not build a milestone table without the scope tracker
Marks unknown milestone status explicitly instead of inferring it
